Usage: gokart new (create,init) [<project> ...] [flags]

Create a new GoKart project (no project name on a terminal starts an interactive
wizard).

Arguments:
  [<project> ...]    Project name or path (e.g. my-app); also accepts the preset
                     form "<preset> <project>" (e.g. "cli my-app"). Run with no
                     project on a terminal to start the interactive wizard.

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Print version information and quit.

Project
  --flat             Use a single-package root layout (default; Kong-based CLI).
  --structured       Use a managed cmd/ and internal/ layout (Kong-based) for
                     later gokart add integrations.
  --module=STRING    Go module path.
  --example          Include a runnable Kong greet command and tests.

Integrations / Configuration
  --db="none"              Database backend (managed integration; structured
                           layout).
  --ai                     Include OpenAI client (managed integration;
                           structured layout).
  --redis                  Include Redis cache (managed integration; structured
                           layout).
  --local                  Use local-only config (no global config directory).
  --global                 Enable global config in the user config directory.
  --config-scope="auto"    Config scope: auto, local, or global.

Safety / Verification
  --dry-run              Preview scaffold operations without writing project
                         files. Still runs go get and go mod tidy (network)
                         in a temporary copy, plus tests and build unless
                         --no-verify.
  --force                Overwrite existing files that the scaffold generates
                         (other files are left alone).
  --skip-existing        Skip files that already exist.
  --no-manifest          Opt a structured project out of GoKart management.
  --verify               Force post-generation tests and build.
  --no-verify            Skip tests and build, but still prepare dependencies.
  --verify-only          Tidy, test, and build an existing project without
                         scaffolding.
  --verify-timeout=5m    Maximum verification time; zero disables timeout.

Automation
  --json    Print machine-readable JSON result.
